title: Izanagi
body:
Syntax: izanagi

Description: Toggle this Mangekyo technique if it is one of your assigned eye abilities. Sharingan must be active to turn it on and remain active for Izanagi to save you; immortals may test without it. While active, it saves you from your next defeat, restoring full Health and switching itself off. The 24-hour real-time cooldown begins only when it actually saves you. You can toggle Izanagi off even if Sharingan fades. Your individual eye help becomes visible after your first use.

Date: 2026-09-27
